name: find_text
description: Search the active tab's visible page for text matching `query` (case-insensitive substring match). Returns each match's text plus the nearest clickable ancestor's index, so you can click the result directly without doing a separate observation pass. Number of results is capped server-side.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Required text to search for. Case-insensitive substring match.

inputs.name: include_observation
inputs.description: When true, include the full interactive elements[] in the observation. Default false: the result carries matches[] (each with clickable_ancestor_index, enough to click the result directly) plus basics-only tab metadata. Set true only if you need to act on a different element than the search hit.
